item.text:
Integrity check confirms both load-bearing claims are current:

- **Identity:** `diff -rq` between the read-only source and the pristine `raft@v1.7.3` module cache shows no content differences — only the two nested-module directories (`fuzzy`, `raft-compat`) that the module zip excludes. The artifact is unmodified upstream v1.7.3.
- **Finding 1 fix:** `TestAudit_EnsureSamePeers_Fixed` passes (`ok ... 0.552s`) — the refreshed-`peerSet` variant is stable.

The audit is complete. Final deliverable: [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-08_13-11-14-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md).

**Result in one line:** the supplied code is unmodified upstream `hashicorp/raft` v1.7.3, and the one concrete, reproducible defect I confirmed is a test-harness bug — `EnsureSamePeers` (`testing.go:692-715`) caches `c.rafts[0]`'s configuration once and never refreshes it, causing nondeterministic `testing.go:705 peer mismatch` failures across its 10 callers (root-caused, and the one-line fix verified 20/20). No defect was found in the core consensus/agreement logic, backed by executed negative evidence (full non-network suite clean under `-race`, committed-entry churn soak with zero loss, snapshot region 50/50 under `-race`, clean build/vet).

Reproduction artifacts are preserved under `work/audit/` (14 logs) plus the diagnostic-only `audit_diag_test.go`; `source/` was never modified. Open items (network transport, nested `fuzzy`/`raft-compat` modules, disk-backed/restart soak) are recorded in §5.
